about: Dolbeau-Mistassini is a city in Quebec’s Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean region, at the confluence of the Mistassini and Mistassibi rivers north of Lac Saint-Jean. Pulp heritage, blueberry country, and a northern resource-town character define the amalgamated community. About 14,000 people live in Dolbeau-Mistassini.
